scripts.check: pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:js && pnpm run check:py
scripts.check:js: pnpm -r --if-present run lint && pnpm -r --if-present run build && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.check:py: cd services/backend && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run pytest -q
scripts.gen:events: node packages/shared/scripts/gen-events.mjs && cd services/backend && uv run -q ruff format -q app/events.py && uv run -q ruff check -q --fix app/events.py && uv run -q ruff format -q app/events.py
